title: Models of semilinear finite-fibre restriction diagrams
statement: For a field k, a semilinear diagram records schemes X,Y,X',Y' over Spec k, arbitrary diagram arrows f and f', a field automorphism sigma, scheme isomorphisms u and w semilinear over sigma, their commuting equations, and a geometric point y. Using the strict-system counit maps [lem-zl-finite-counit-restriction-towers], construct the Spec k automorphism c, transported point c^-1 y w, the unique fibre-product isomorphism, and the normalized equivalence x maps to c^-1 x u of point indices. The specified pullback compositors and direct-image mates determine source and middle transport; product projections determine sum transport by the point equivalence and stalk compositors. A square retains its four objects and arrows; image and full-subcategory restriction retain these arrows. The exchange and restriction squares use the actual counit maps on whole system complexes. Their Roos and completed realizations are the images under the fixed restriction/Roos and localization/total-limit functors. This is a relocation of existing constructions, with identical names and bodies; it introduces no second notion.
